summary: rtems mirror CI: build erc32 + run POSIX tests on SIS, CodeQL C/C++, SonarCloud
epic_summary: WS-F Quality gates (Actions build+test on SIS, CodeQL, SonarCloud, SBOM, OSV, Dependabot)
description:
Repo: github.com/vishal7pandey/rtems (public mirror). Branch the workflow off `main` AND cherry-pick it onto `tc1/5776-base` so the TC1 PR gets checks.

## Do

* `.github/workflows/anvil-ci.yml` on `pull_request`: job in `container: ghcr.io/vishal7pandey/anvil-sandbox-rtems:7`, build erc32 with `BUILD_TESTS` limited to psxtests + samples, run them with `rtems-test --rtems-bsp=erc32-sis`, upload logs, fail on any test failure.
* CodeQL C/C++ in manual build mode (same container build).
* SonarCloud scan (see `C:\Dev\ai-software-factory\docs\sonarcloud.md`; owner adds the `SONAR_TOKEN` secret). C/C++ in SonarCloud needs a compilation database: generate with `bear` or waf's `compile_commands.json`.
* Dependabot: `github-actions` ecosystem only (say so in the PR: no package manifests in the kernel).

## Acceptance

* A dummy PR shows three checks (build-test, CodeQL, Sonar) green on `tc1/5776-base`. Total CI time noted (target < 20 min).
